name: Event-Scoped Sales Dashboard Authorization
goal: Constrain every existing Sales dashboard read and mutation to server-configured Event grants derived from the authenticated dashboard identity.
dependencies: P0-D Revocation Completeness and Purchase Ceiling

authority.valid_value: Comma-separated positive integer Event IDs, trimmed, sorted, and deduplicated.
authority.malformed_nonblank: Runtime configuration error; reject the entire value and prevent startup.

audit_ownership.Conversation: uniquely related sales_orders.whatsapp_conversation_id to Order.event_id; state_data is not authority
audit_ownership.PaymentEvent: unique provider/reference match to PaymentAttempt then Order; unmatched or ambiguous rows are hidden
audit_ownership.StateTransition: resolve referenced entity owner; unsupported or ambiguous owner is denied

performance.query_filter: SQL/Ash Event ownership filters using existing Event and Order indexes

deferred_surfaces: general root-dashboard Event administration and sync

acceptance: A-only grant permits Event A and denies Event B across Sales reads and mutations
Explicit A+B grants permit both Events
Empty grants fail closed for Sales Event-owned data
Malformed runtime grants reject the complete configuration
Rejected cross-event mutations create no successful audit action or Oban job and perform no Redis mutation
Existing payment, refund, revocation, inventory, and scanner authority remains unchanged

operator_authority_decision.dashboard_revocation: Configured dashboard-admin identity with server-owned Event grants only.
operator_authority_decision.core_operator_capability: Retained in FastCheck.Tickets.Revocation as a domain capability; the core does not authenticate callers.
operator_authority_decision.follow_up: FastCheckin-iuaq: establish trusted operator identity and Event authority before adding a production entry point.

global_worker_monitoring.reason: Global and unattributable Oban jobs have no safe Event owner.
global_worker_monitoring.launch_readiness: NO-GO until an approved global monitoring source and rehearsed procedure exist.
